answer: An attester must stake 49% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. Because the island stake is held until the lotus settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the ledge audit lists each exposure. A farm running 74 keys thus pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
